cookies.banner: We use cookies to sign you in and remember your settings — nothing else. No ads, no tracking.
cookies.necessaryDesc: Signing in, security and this consent choice. Always on — the site can't work without them.
cookies.preferencesDesc: Remembers choices like your language so you don't have to pick them again.
cookies.analyticsDesc: We don't use any analytics cookies today. If that ever changes, they stay off unless you allow them here.
